Game Overview

At its heart, Ninja Parakite is a arcade game about become a skilled ninja in Ninja Parakite, where you glide through tricky terrains using an ingenious parakite. Master timing and accuracy as you dodge obstacles, gather bananas, and locate your ally in increasingly challenging levels. Agile navigation and exploration unlock hidden secrets along your thrilling journey.
